title: Canonical normalized ordinary tensor-completion presentation
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], and a scheme W [def-pc-scheme]. Use completed integral coefficients on its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site, def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], the actual unbounded derived module category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and signed total tensor of cochain sheaves [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. Let T be the recorded ordinary tensor, C the canonical completion, eta its canonical unit, and e the restriction of the K-flat tensor representative comparison [def-pur-integral-derived-operations]. Assume ell is invertible in every residue field of W. There is a natural isomorphism beta:T followed by C isomorphic to the specified completed tensor. On each pair of good complexes its composite with eta and the recorded completed-tensor comparison equals e inverse followed by the localization of the canonical Roos augmentation and normalized tensor-tower map [lem-pur-integral-ambient-operation-models]. This asserts no completeness or constructibility of either input.

proof.text: Restrict the recorded duality-model tensor comparison along the inclusion of flat-term K-flat good complexes. Keep the native ordinary tensor, completion, unit and canonical augmentation map in explicitly typed irreducible wrappers. Fix sheafification at the canonical coefficient universe. The actual native data are used directly; the packed ambient presentation is transported only inside the comparison proof. No new choice is made.

Invertibility in each residue field implies invertibility in each stalk by the local residue map. Apply integralAmbientOperationModels to the identity of W. Retain its normalized tensor augmentation clause, discard its other unused clause, and rewrite the copied ambient package by its proved equality with the actual raw package.

Take the supplied comparison beta and transport its augmentation equation through the definitional identifications of the actual categories, total tensor, representative comparison and completion unit. The equation is retained exactly; no existence theorem selecting an arbitrary tensor operation is used.

lean.statement:
theorem tensorCompletionModel
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)] :
    ∃ β : ordinaryTensor l E W ⋙ tensorCompletionFunctor l E W ≅
        integralCompletedTensor l E W,
      ∀ P Q : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E W).FullSubcategory,
        (tensorCompletionUnit l E W).app
            ((ordinaryTensor l E W).obj
              (((integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W).prod
                (integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W)).obj (P, Q))) ≫
          β.hom.app (((integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W).prod
            (integralOperationsGoodLocalization l E W)).obj (P, Q)) ≫
          (integralCompletedTensorComparison l E W).hom.app (P, Q) =
        (tensorRepresentativeIso l E W).inv.app (P, Q) ≫
          DerivedCategory.Q.map (tensorCompletionUnitMap l E W P.obj Q.obj)
